messages:
incident-bot: HIGH-PRIORITY ALERT: 429 spike detected for tenant client-omega in vpc-prod-3 (dedicated pool). 5m error-rate 14% (baseline ~0.5%). Trigger: quota_exceeded. Paging eng-oncall and eng-sre.
support-lead: i'm picking this up — customer-reported errors + support ticket #7891. client-omega is enterprise (VPC, dedicated pool). please advise mitigation options. cc @account-pm
oncall-ryan: i'm oncall. landing now. pulling logs and request traces. can someone paste the exact metric query we used?
eng-sre-lead: quick snapshot: sustained spike in inbound QPS from client-omega starting ~08:12 UTC. concurrent requests spiked x2.5 and many long-running streams causing queue backlog -> token generation queue fills -> 429s from per-tenant quota enforcement. other tenants in the same pool saw latency jitter but not 429s yet.
alice: support ticket says customer kicked off a large onboarding job / data-import at 08:11 UTC. they didn't intentionally change rate limits on their side. account-pm is talking to them.
eng-sre-lead: short-term options: 1) temporary per-tenant quota increase (emergency lift) 2) apply strict per-tenant queue weight limiting to prevent head-of-line blocking 3) route non-critical calls to model-compact fallback 4) ask customer to pause job. fastest = emergency lift.
account-pm: customer asks for a short lift so their job can finish. legal/compliance on call said temporary exception is OK if we log it and bill accordingly. requested window: 30-60min.
support-lead: need SRE approval for manual override. also confirm isolation risk — is this per-tenant change going to affect other ent tenants?
eng-sre-lead: we can increase client-omega's QPS cap in the control plane for vpc-prod-3 only. risk: higher load on pool (cpu/mem). i'll continue to monitor. propose +6x for 30m then auto-revert. also enable fallback routing for low-priority endpoints.
eng-sre-lead: ops commands below (copying for audit):
```
# bump client-omega temporary quota
/repo ops quota update --tenant client-omega --pool vpc-prod-3 --qps 1200 --duration 1800
# enable fallback routing rule for non-critical endpoints
/repo infra route add --tenant client-omega --route "/api/generate/low_priority" --model model-compact --weight 1
```
ops-bot: executing: /repo ops quota update --tenant client-omega --pool vpc-prod-3 --qps 1200 --duration 1800
ops-bot: SUCCESS: client-omega qps 200 -> 1200 (temp, 1800s). change id: CHG-20260315-447
oncall-ryan: monitoring in grafana now. initial metric: error-rate 429 14% -> 1.8% within 60s. queue depth decreasing. cpu on pool rose from 56% -> 72%.
support-lead: account-pm looped back: customer confirms their job completed the heavy portion and will throttle remaining requests if we hold lift for 30m. they appreciate quick response.
eng-sre-lead: confirming no cross-tenant regressions in last 5m, tracing looks clean. i'm marking mitigation = temporary lift + routing fallback. will create postmortem for threshold tuning and client guidance.
account-pm: note: customer requests a confirmation email and the audit log. @support-lead can you send closure note and billing ack?
support-lead: will do. drafting message now. include change id CHG-20260315-447 and timeframe.
eng-sre-lead: follow-up actions: 1) drop-to-normal at 30m if no further surge (ops-bot auto-revert scheduled) 2) add client-specific retry guidance to onboarding docs 3) tighten alert thresholds to detect retry storms earlier
oncall-ryan: handing off monitoring to @sam. my shift ends in 15m. sam, i'll DM you current dashboards and traces.
sam: ack, i'm taking the handoff. i'll monitor for 2h and escalate if errors climb above 3% again. good work team :white_check_mark:
support-lead: incident labeled sev2, ticket #INC-20260315-89. postmortem owner: eng-sre-lead. ETA for postmortem draft: EOD tomorrow.
incident-bot: incident closure checklist: mitigation active, rollback scheduled, postmortem assigned.
sam: noted. leaving a short summary for oncall notes: temporary quota lift granted to client-omega in vpc-prod-3 for 30m due to onboarding surge; fallback routing added; monitoring shows error-rate recovery. will update if anything changes.
